entries.text: I have arrived.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_first_00

entries.text: You may call me Mr. Saguaro.\c\nI look forward to working with you.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_first_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So it WAS you who called me here, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_00

entries.text: I had heard that an extraordinary exchange\nstudent making a name for themselves here was\r\ntasked with gathering talent.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_01

entries.text: I was curious to see what kind of student could\nearn such high renown, but well... Now that I\r\nfind you here, it all makes sense.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_02

entries.text: Thank you!
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_select_01

entries.text: I know, right?
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_select_02

entries.text: Heh... You do not hide your talent, do you? A\nkey to your success, no doubt.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_03

entries.text: Heh... You have a sense of humor about all this,\ndon’t you? A key to your success, no doubt.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_03b

entries.text: Seeing a student of mine achieve such great\nthings brings me joy.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_04

entries.text: I’ll do my best here to try and match your own\naccomplishments.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp01_05

entries.text: You see, I recently decided to get a case for my\nRotom Phone.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_01

entries.text: Now, tell me... Did I put it on right?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_02

entries.text: Looks good!
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_select_01

entries.text: Cute case!
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_select_02

entries.text: Arven has that case!
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_select_03

entries.text: Thank goodness! This is the very first time I’ve\nattempted something like this...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_03

entries.text: Oh! So you think so as well?! I’m also very fond\nof this case![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_03b

entries.text: Oh? So we have matching cases now, it seems...\nThat boy Arven’s got quite good taste.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_03c

entries.text:
I searched everywhere to get my hands on it,
you know.\c
As it turns out, the Flabébé Flower Case is sold
only in Cascarrafa.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_04

entries.text: I’m quite pleased that I was able to find it in\nthe end.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp02_05

entries.text: Allow me to share some good information with\nyou, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_00

entries.text: You can find the Cream Pokémon Milcery in\nthe Terarium.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_01

entries.text: Not only is it adorable, but it also emits a\nsweet fragrance. It’s hard to put into words\r\njust how lovely it is...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_02

entries.text: Are you aware of the peculiar way in which one\ngets Milcery to evolve?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_03

entries.text: By spinning around
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_select_01

entries.text: By calling it cute
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_select_02

entries.text: By feeding it something sweet
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_select_03

entries.text: That is indeed correct. Have you by chance tried\nthis yourself already?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_04

entries.text: Well, yes, telling your Pokémon how cute it is\nwill put you both in a lovely mood, but it’s\r\nnot going to evolve from that.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_04b

entries.text: Oh, that’d be lovely if it evolved by eating a\ntasty Peanut Butter Sandwich...\c\nBut, alas, I don’t think that’s ever happened.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_04c

entries.text: If you want a Milcery to evolve, put it in your\nparty and spin around a few times.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_05

entries.text: When you do that, its cream gets whisked around\nand causes it to become a fluffy Alcremie.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_06

entries.text: But don’t forget to have your Milcery hold onto\na Sweet item before you attempt this![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_07

entries.text: And be aware that Alcremie’s form will change\ndepending on the Sweet it was holding, as well as\r\nthe way you spin around.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_08

entries.text: To get my Alcremie looking the way she does, I\nhad to fine-tune my spin with absolute precision![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_sp03_09

entries.text: You know, the only reason I was able to meet my\nAlcremie was because you called me here.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_00

entries.text: You must have met plenty of wonderful Pokémon\non your travels, no?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_01

entries.text: Why don’t we trade? A Pokémon from you could\ndo much to enlighten me about your journey.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_02

entries.text: Hmmm... I’ll trade my Hattrem. What about you,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Yes, I feel like I have a newfound appreciation
for all the adventures you’ve been on.\c
I thank you for the trade, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_01_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, you’d like to trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for
my
Hattrem,
yes?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Saguaro a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Saguaro such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Mr. Saguaro a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_02_03

entries.text:
...Ah. Sorry, I’m afraid we can’t trade if you’ve
only got one Pokémon with you.\c
Why don’t we try this again once you have at
least two in your party?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_03_00

entries.text: Just let me know when you’d like to trade.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_03_01

entries.text: Would you like to trade with me?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_trade_04_00

entries.text: Oh? Are you interested in battling me,\nChampion?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_talkto_00

entries.text: I’m quite ready for a battle. Just let me know\nwhen.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_cancel_00

entries.text: Yes, of course, let’s battle. I won’t hold back.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: Hmmm, I thought I had trained plenty enough...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: But I should expect no less from a Champion.\nYour potential for growth is unparalleled.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: You must be tired after battling. Take these.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: Sour foods do wonders for exhaustion.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 66]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_reward_00

entries.text: My, no matter how many battles we have, they\nnever cease to be sweet.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: Thank you for asking me to battle.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
It isn’t like you to lose like that. You seemed...
distracted?\c
Be sure to take care of yourself and show your
Pokémon some love.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: My class here is quite popular—it’s about healthy\nmeals to feed Pokémon after battles. Why don’t\r\nyou join us sometime?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
Don’t you think it remarkable that rain falls in the
Terarium?\c
One can have their picnic spoiled by a sudden
downpour there, just like anywhere else.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
Have you tried the Academy Shake? You can
order it in the cafeteria.\c
It’s so sweet it’ll make your tongue go numb.
It’s hard not to smile when you drink it.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] positively gleams! You
must
have
given it a carefully balanced diet, no?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_03

entries.text: How is the Hattrem I traded you faring? Her\ncuteness really is unmatched, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_home_randomtalk_04
